intro: Mark a yahrzeit, a birthday, an anniversary, a new baby or a recovery the Jewish way: by sharing it with the community and giving in the merit of the person you love. Every sponsorship carries your dedication, and the Rabbi mentions it.

occasions.title: A yahrzeit
occasions.text: Honor a loved one's memory and elevate their soul.

occasions.title: A birthday
occasions.text: Celebrate with the community. A birthday is a personal Rosh Hashanah.

occasions.title: An anniversary
occasions.text: Give thanks for the years together.

occasions.title: A new baby
occasions.text: Welcome a new Jewish soul with joy.
occasions.dedication: In honor of the birth of {name}

occasions.title: A bar or bat mitzvah
occasions.text: Celebrate the milestone with the whole community.

occasions.title: A recovery
occasions.text: Pray for, or give thanks for, a complete recovery.

occasions.title: In honor of someone
occasions.text: A parent, a teacher, a friend: anyone you want to honor.

options.title: Sponsor the Shabbat Kiddush
options.text: The whole community celebrates with you after Shabbat services. Your dedication is announced and shown on the Kiddush board.

options.title: Sponsor a Shabbat dinner
options.text: Give the gift of a Shabbat table to families, students and newcomers.

options.title: Sponsor a Torah class
options.text: Dedicate a week of Torah learning in their merit.

options.title: Sponsor a children's program
options.text: Hebrew School, CKids and holiday programs for children.

options.title: Preschool scholarship
options.text: Help a child attend Lamorinda Jewish Preschool.

options.title: Sponsor a holiday program
options.text: Chanukah, Purim, Passover and more for the whole community.

options.title: Give tzedakah in their merit
options.text: Any amount, where it is needed most.
